name: Mary Magdalene
background: From Magdala. After being healed by Jesus, she became one of His most devoted followers and financial supporters, present at both the cross and the tomb.

genericReactions.physical: Objects can hold memories. This one reminds me of His kindness.
genericReactions.testimonial: I know what He did for me. My life is my testimony.
genericReactions.digital: I don't know of such things. I only know what I have seen and heard from Him.
genericReactions.environmental: I remember the garden. I thought He was the gardener, until He spoke my name.
genericReactions.analytical: You can't measure what He did for me. He cast out seven demons. How do you count that?
genericReactions.prophecy: I don't know the ancient words, but I know He is the one they spoke of.
